note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list. Hidden flags follow the PSNProfiles / Exophase listing as of the bounty opening (28 hidden). Guides are written for this entry in its own words; where a guide adds steps beyond the official description it is marked verified:false and says so. The list holds no online trophies, so the app's online filter is empty by design.

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list and the platinum unlocks on its own — it is the last one you will get. Treat the three roadmap stages as the order: story first, Leonida cleanup second, the long grinds last. The counter at the top of this guide only hits 55/55 when the platinum pops.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing — play through it and the trophy pops at the end. There is nothing to miss and nothing to prepare; it is the game's first story beat. Start the roadmap here and let the story trophies fall in order.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story progress only — no side content is needed for it, so push the main missions until the chapter card lands and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same rule as the other chapter trophies: follow the main story. While you play, keep the missable trophy in mind — meditate at every spot you pass, because it cannot be repeated later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy that needs nothing but the main missions. By now the partner missions are open too — they feed the partner trophies in stage 1 and 2.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale. If you have been meditating at every spot and trying the activities you pass, the cleanup in stage 2 will be much shorter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Gold, and the story's last trophy before the cleanup stages. Once it pops, the whole map and every activity are open for stage 2 — nothing story-gated is left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission — it unlocks as the story reaches it, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; no preparation beyond reaching it in the story, and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — follow the main missions until it appears, finish it, and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Another story mission trophy: it unlocks in the story's order and pops when the mission is done.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only. The airport setting also matters for a later activity trophy, so remember the layout when you come back in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies — finish it and every mission trophy in stage 1 is accounted for except the chapter and finale ones.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own completion checklist, not this tracker's 55. It is gold and it is last: story, all side missions, all collectibles and all activities feed into it. Use the in-game stats page to find what is still missing; this guide's stage 3 is built around it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts — they count in free roam, so they pile up naturally while you drive between objectives. Details unconfirmed: the exact stunt list and whether every stunt type counts the same — check the cited guide before grinding the last fifty.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or finish any of them — one attempt at each type is enough. Open the activities menu and work down the list; the trophy pops on the ninth type.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge can be retried, so a silver first run costs nothing — replay it until it turns gold. Details unconfirmed: which ranges hold which challenges and the gold thresholds — the cited guide maps them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 of them. One win per location is enough, so visit each race once you can win it and move on. Details unconfirmed: the race locations map — the cited guide lists all 14.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list and tick each new win; repeats add nothing. Details unconfirmed: the full race list and which events count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also feeds the activity trophy — take the challenge when it appears and out-fish Cal. Details unconfirmed: where the challenge unlocks and its scoring.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one, any one. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it to its end; the trophy pops on completion, win or lose, as long as you finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through the story — finish his last mission and the trophy pops. Do his missions as they appear so nothing is left for the cleanup.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other character finales: follow his strand to its last mission and finish it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish his strand's last mission; the trophy is story progress, not a grind.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore the state — each strand is a short chain, and eight finished chains earn the silver. Details unconfirmed: the strand locations and which strangers offer them — the cited guide maps all of them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow his strand to its last mission and finish it — another character finale in stage 1.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. The last of the five character finales — finish his strand and stage 1's story trophies are nearly done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots — and this is the game's ONLY missable trophy. Do it as you play the story: whenever you pass a meditation spot, stop and meditate, because spots tied to story areas cannot be revisited later. Details unconfirmed: the 18 spot locations — use the cited guide's map and tick them off here as you go.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-off quarry, not regular hunting — find the animal he wants and take it down. Details unconfirmed: which animal it is and where it roams.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set completes when every card in it is found, and three finished sets earn the silver. Details unconfirmed: the card locations — the cited guide maps every set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The counter climbs one location at a time, so treat it as a background grind while you explore — it finishes on its own if you keep using the feature everywhere you go. Details unconfirmed: the 100-spot map in the cited guide.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; the in-game challenges list tracks them, so work through it instead of guessing. Details unconfirmed: the full challenge list and which ones are quickest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the heat to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight until it clears — do not lose your partner on the way out. Details unconfirmed: the easiest escape routes — the cited guide lists a few.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three robberies in one wanted run — plan a route of three close shops before you start, and keep moving between them. Details unconfirmed: the best shop route.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct vehicles. Variety counts, not repeats, so take every new car, bike, boat and plane you see for at least a short drive. Details unconfirmed: the full vehicle list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — one target at a time will not do it. Details unconfirmed: the best farming spot for a five-enemy group.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way no timetable allows. Details unconfirmed: the exact trigger, whether it is a plane, a runway stunt or something else — check the cited guide before you try it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke, not instructions: deal with Rhino tanks — the army's main battle tank, when it shows up. Details unconfirmed: how many Rhinos and where they appear.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no one spotting you. Go quiet: enter, take the goods, leave before anyone reacts. Details unconfirmed: the best store and approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape — plan the getaway before you go in. Details unconfirmed: the vault locations and which banks hold them.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take the cash, and get clear before the response arrives. Details unconfirmed: the truck spawn routes and the best ambush spots.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks visited areas; drive or walk into each one and the counter climbs. Details unconfirmed: the area map — the cited guide marks all 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang — nine total — so you need to find every gang's turf, not just repeat the nearest one. Details unconfirmed: the operation locations per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — the trophy is the moment, not a mission. Details unconfirmed: the exact bar and drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive in, then drive straight out through the glass — the classic GTA exit. Details unconfirmed: which showroom and the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley — the trophy is about the place, so any game there should do it. Details unconfirmed: how to reach the alley and whether a full game is needed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story-flavoured moment with your partner — it comes from playing together, not from a menu. Details unconfirmed: the exact trigger and when in the story it opens.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count to 500 — choices across the game add up, so keep choosing and the trophy lands on its own in the long run. Details unconfirmed: which choices count toward the 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail, then succeed on the second try — the description says it all, so the trophy is about the retry, not the win. Details unconfirmed: which activity it triggers on.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd events, and this trophy is one of them. Details unconfirmed: the event itself and where it happens — the cited guide's easter-egg pages are the place to look.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but up close and personal. Details unconfirmed: the easiest setup and whether any vehicle works.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; launder them through contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a long grind, so feed it every robbery payout instead of saving it for last. Details unconfirmed: the contact locations and the laundering rates.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes, food — any shop spending counts and it adds up across the whole game, so it lands on its own if you shop normally. Details unconfirmed: whether property purchases count toward it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Buy each garage as it becomes available; the trophy pops on the eighth. Details unconfirmed: the garage locations and prices.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten distinct vehicles in the app — variety counts, so use ten different rides. Details unconfirmed: how registration works per vehicle and whether any vehicle qualifies.
trophies.name: On the Spot
